000.observed: Frontal head and chin are lifted with the eyes directed upward.
000.reason: The vertical up cardinal is unmistakable and has no competing horizontal turn.

022.5.observed: Strong upward head pitch with a subtle beginning screen-right face and gaze shift.
022.5.reason: Up is clear and the right axis is subtle near the vertical cardinal; the labeled 000→022.5→045 arc advances coherently toward screen-right.

045.observed: Face and nose turn screen-right while the chin and gaze remain elevated.
045.reason: Both the rightward horizontal axis and upward vertical axis are plainly visible.

067.5.observed: Strong screen-right three-quarter turn with a restrained upward head and eye pitch.
067.5.reason: The right axis is unmistakable; the subtler up axis remains coherent in the labeled 045→067.5→090 progression.

090.observed: Head, facial plane, and nose form a clear screen-right profile.
090.reason: The right cardinal is unmistakable and passed the blind hard gate.

112.5.observed: Screen-right profile is retained while the eyelids, gaze, and head begin pitching downward.
112.5.reason: The right axis is clear; the subtler down axis progresses coherently through the labeled 090→112.5→135 arc.

135.observed: Head remains turned screen-right with lowered eyes and chin.
135.reason: Both the rightward horizontal axis and downward vertical axis read clearly.

157.5.observed: Deep downward head and eye pitch retains a slight screen-right yaw.
157.5.reason: Both axes remain readable; the continuity warning into 180 is tail and head foreshortening rather than a semantic reversal.

180.observed: Frontal head is bowed with the eyes directed down.
180.reason: The down cardinal is unmistakable and passed the blind hard gate.

202.5.observed: Lowered head and gaze begin turning screen-left from the down cardinal.
202.5.reason: Both the leftward horizontal axis and downward vertical axis are visible.

225.observed: Face turns screen-left in three-quarter view while the eyes and chin remain lowered.
225.reason: Both required axes are clear in the down-left quadrant.

247.5.observed: Strong screen-left orientation retains a restrained downward head and eye pitch.
247.5.reason: The left axis is dominant and the down axis remains visible before 270.

270.observed: Head, facial plane, and nose form a clear screen-left profile.
270.reason: The left cardinal is unmistakable and passed the blind hard gate.

292.5.observed: Screen-left profile is retained while the chin and gaze begin lifting.
292.5.reason: Both the leftward horizontal axis and upward vertical axis are visible.

315.observed: Face remains distinctly screen-left with a clearly elevated head and gaze.
315.reason: Both required axes read strongly in the up-left quadrant.

337.5.observed: Strong upward pitch returns near frontal while retaining a subtle screen-left face and gaze cue.
337.5.reason: Up is clear and the left axis is appropriately subtle one step before 000; the labeled loop resolves the blind ambiguity without reversal.
